description: List the forex brokers forex.mobile reviews, highest editorial score first, with score, published minimum deposit and lowest published spread, retail regulators, platforms, Trustpilot rating and an affiliateUrl. Optional filters: country (only brokers whose own restricted-countries list was read and does not exclude it), islamic (only brokers whose own site offers a swap-free account), maxMinDeposit (USD) and platform. Broker scores are forex.mobile's editorial ratings out of 5, written by a named reviewer from each broker's published terms, regulator records and Trustpilot ratings. Spreads, deposits and platforms are the figures each broker publishes; forex.mobile does not trade real money with brokers or measure live spreads or execution. Methodology: https://forex.mobile/methodology

country.description: Country slug (e.g. uae, vietnam, india) or two-letter ISO code. Slugs: uae, saudi-arabia, kuwait, egypt, india, australia, uk, canada, nigeria, south-africa, france, singapore, us-traders, vietnam, thailand, philippines, indonesia, malaysia, japan, hong-kong, pakistan, kazakhstan, mongolia, ghana, bangladesh, kenya, morocco, tanzania, brazil, colombia, germany, italy, spain, netherlands, sweden, switzerland, sri-lanka, qatar, mexico

islamic.description: true: only brokers whose own site says it offers an Islamic (swap-free) account

maxMinDeposit.description: Only brokers whose published minimum deposit is at most this many US dollars

platform.description: Only brokers that list this platform, e.g. MT4, MT5, cTrader, TradingView
